answer: In 2025 L'Oreal reported 100% own-workforce coverage by its health and safety management system, zero fatalities from work-related injury or ill health, 270 recordable work-related accidents, an enlarged Total Incident Rate of 1.37 and a Lost Time Injury Rate of 0.67. The accident metric excludes workdays lost owing to commutes and first-aid accidents.
